_fields.revision: The exact commit of the source. Pinned, not a branch: a branch moves, and two runs months apart would draw on different collections.
_fields.seed: Seed for the stratified sample. The same seed reproduces the same selection.
_fields.max_per_family: Cap per dataset family. PMLB carries large families from one source (fri_c*, analcatdata_*); without a cap one kind of data would dominate a band.
_fields.per_stratum: Datasets kept per size-band x task-type cell. Six cells, so roughly six times this number survive.
_fields.counts.considered: Every dataset in the source at this revision.
_fields.counts.eligible: Passed the selection rules, before sampling.
_fields.counts.kept: Survived the stratified sample. These are what the study runs on.
_fields.counts.excluded: Everything not kept, each with a reason. Nothing disappears silently.
_fields.missingness_rates: Fractions of predictor cells blanked at evaluation time (D-015). The source ships pre-cleaned data, so the recommender's missing-value heuristic would otherwise go untested.
_fields.coverage: How many kept datasets exercise each characteristic the recommender reasons about. Zeros are shown rather than omitted: an invisible empty band is a claim the study cannot support.
_fields.datasets: The collection the study runs on.
_fields.datasets[].name: Identifier within the source.
_fields.datasets[].task: classification or regression, as the source states it. Carried explicitly because it cannot be derived from `classes`: the source does not zero that field for regression, and inferring from it files every regression dataset as classification.
_fields.datasets[].classes: Distinct target values. Only meaningful for classification — regression datasets also carry a value here.
_fields.datasets[].missing_values: null means the source does not report it, which is not the same as zero. PMLB publishes no such column because its data is pre-cleaned; hence the injected rates above.
_fields.datasets[].imbalance: How far class proportions sit from equal: 0 is a perfect split, 0.94 is the most skewed present. Only meaningful for classification, though the source populates it for regression too.
_fields.excluded: Every dataset considered and not kept, with why. A collection whose gaps cannot be explained invites the suspicion that datasets were chosen to flatter the heuristics.
_fields.excluded[].name: Identifier of the excluded dataset.
_fields.excluded[].reason: Why this dataset is absent: out of the product's scope, synthetic, deprecated by the source, or eligible but not sampled.
_fields.fetch_failures: Datasets that could not be downloaded or whose shape disagreed with the index. Recorded rather than raised, so one bad entry does not cost the whole run.
